d:
Diwali is one of the busiest travel seasons for Indian Railways, with lakhs of passengers travelling home to celebrate the festival. But why do trains get delayed during Diwali? How is Indian Railways preparing to handle the massive festive rush this year? And what special arrangements are being made for passengers?
In this special interview, Prashant Singh speaks to Northern Railway CPRO Himanshu Shekhar Upadhyay about the railway's preparations for Diwali, special trains, passenger facilities, crowd management, train delays and the challenges of handling the festive rush.
